description: This file initializes the i18n internationalization library, configuring it with multiple language resources (English, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Hindi) for a frontend web project. It imports translation JSON files for each language and sets up i18n with react-i18next integration, specifying default language and fallback options.

methods.name: use
methods.description: Method from i18n to add plugins or modules, used here with initReactI18next.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Method to initialize i18n with the specified configuration, including resources and languages.

calls: i18n.init?.({ resources: { en, ta, te, kn, hi }, lng: 'en', fallbackLng: 'en', interpolation: { escapeValue: false } })
